name: ceditor
description: Backend monorepo: API gateway, services and shared packages (the Next.js frontend is a separate project in frontend/)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ceditor/common && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: eslint packages api-gateway auth-service user-service code-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @ceditor/common && tsc --noEmit -p api-gateway && tsc --noEmit -p auth-service && tsc --noEmit -p user-service && tsc --noEmit -p code-service
